name: Mask Trim Edges Before Wall Finish
intent: Apply tape and paper to every painted trim substrate's wall-adjacent edge before wall finish coats. Each task reads its own substrate-specific PS key so masking does not double-count. Trim package must be installed and finished prior to this module.
doctrine: Each masking task reads its own substrate-specific PS_PROTECT_LF.TRIM_<SUBSTRATE> key. Per-substrate emission is gated on (subs.walls && substrate painting), so an inactive trim substrate emits 0 LF and its task contributes 0 hours. Track A 2026-05-02: extended the original 3-substrate isolation (baseboard / door casing / window casing) to all 11 wall-adjacent trim substrates so quantities remain isolated for future per-substrate height-band override (Track B) and per-substrate opt-out flags (future UI tab). Excludes shoe_mold (sits on baseboard, not wall-adjacent) and door_frames (inside opening).
